LanguageData.LP_StabilizeRot.label: stabilize rot stew
LanguageData.LP_StabilizeRot.description: Boil 20 twisted meat and 2 chemfuel into 2 aberrant paste. Aberrant paste doesn't rot.
LanguageData.LP_BrewTrollRegenAberrant.label: brew troll regenerant (aberrant paste)
LanguageData.LP_BrewTrollRegenAberrant.description: Replace 4 troll blood with 3 aberrant paste: brew 1 troll regenerant from 3 aberrant paste + 1 troll blood.
LanguageData.LP_BrewAberrantSalve.label: brew aberrant regenerative paste
LanguageData.LP_BrewAberrantSalve.description: Brew 1 aberrant regenerative paste from 4 aberrant paste and 1 herbal medicine (medicine, effect close to industrial medicine; 15% chance to leave an aberrant growth when tending).
LanguageData.LP_BrewMorphDraught.label: brew metamorphosis draught
LanguageData.LP_BrewMorphDraught.description: Brew 1 metamorphosis draught from 5 aberrant paste and 1 troll blood.
LanguageData.LP_FarDissection.label: Far Realm dissection
LanguageData.LP_FarDissection.description: Cut 50 twisted meat apart piece by piece to study how the Far Realm twists flesh: gain a little Anomaly knowledge (basic). Once the colony has dissected 500 in total, the research "aberrant lore" completes automatically.\n\nThe dissector has a 5% chance to hear "far-realm whispers" (mood -5, 3 days).
LanguageData.LP_ExtractBioferrite.label: bioferrite extraction
LanguageData.LP_ExtractBioferrite.description: Burn 60 twisted meat and 5 chemfuel into 10 bioferrite in the infernal forge's netherfire. The netherfire needs rest: each colony can extract at most 30 per day (3 times).
LanguageData.LP_TemperColdIronBio.label: temper cold iron (bioferrite)
LanguageData.LP_TemperColdIronBio.description: Quench 5 cold iron from 3 bioferrite and 10 steel in the infernal forge.
LanguageData.LP_Offer_Twisted.label: incinerate twisted meat
LanguageData.LP_Offer_Twisted.description: Burn 30 twisted meat clean before the patron deity: divine favor +1, at most +3 per day. Only works when the patron deity is Kelemvor, Lathander or Shar (Kelemvor and Lathander loathe such unnatural flesh; Shar likes the forgetting it brings).
LanguageData.LP_MakeAberrantGolem.label: make aberrant golem seed
LanguageData.LP_MakeAberrantGolem.description: Make a flesh golem seed from 200 twisted meat and 10 aberrant paste. The awakened golem has "aberrant flesh": damage taken -17% (equivalent to +20% health), slowly heals itself, and splits into 2 small fleshbeast servants when it dies (rotting after 1 day). Otherwise the same as an ordinary flesh golem.
